note: Written after the random-sample-only dev grid had been seen (so the criterion was chosen knowing which dev configs led), but before the dev grid with the operator-pool variant was run and before any Oct 12-14 feature-level number was computed. Only aggregate EVs of the sets (docs/04) and the window busy/quiet split were known.
data_for_selection: pre-Oct-12 rows only (gap-3 random sample, 413 launches; plus operator-pool training rows in the 'pool' variant); walk-forward folds Oct 2-12 in 2-day steps, 15-min embargo
candidates: every 'select' configuration of predictor_wf.py dev with >= 40 OOS test launches and keep share >= 20 %; sizing configs separately
rule_1: best univariate threshold rule by the lower 90 % bound of the dev OOS EV (ties: higher keep share)
rule_2: best model keep-rule by the same criterion (any variant / feature set / target)
rule_3: best sizing rule (size / size_skip) by the one-sided p of its gain over the same size mix assigned at random
evaluation: each frozen rule once on: fresh holdout (150 multi), dense window (915), deep (77), gap-3 post-Oct-12, and all post-Oct-12 pooled; report kept EV, lift over all launches with a launch-bootstrap 90% CI and p, busy rate kept/dropped, AUCs, stresses
success: lift > 0 with bootstrap p < 0.05 on the pooled post-Oct-12 set AND kept EV lower bound above the unselected EV on the window
